text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected — streaming generation p99 = 2.5s (threshold 1.2s) in us-west-2. Spike began ~3m ago. Auto-paging oncall rotation.

mira: ack, I'm on it. joining ops-bridge.

samir: seeing elevated p95 too (~900ms) and occasional streaming stalls where the stream stalls between tokens for ~1.2s. stack: continuous-batching runtime path.

alex: any customer impact reports?

mira: no customer pages yet. svc-telemetry shows increased tail latency for model: open-llama-large-v2 streaming endpoint. Most affected route: /v1/generate/stream (multi-tenant).

pagerduty-bot: @mira assigned incident INC-1807 to you. Priority: P1 — follow runbook 'streaming-slo-breach'.

mira: runbook step 1: collect p95/p99 hist and current batch queue lengths. samir can you dump the last 10m metrics?

samir: running quick query: `sum(rate(streaming_latency_bucket[5m]))` returned spike centred at tokens 41-128. Looks like batch sizes jumped — average batch_size rose from 6 -> 22 in 5m. Mixed sequence lengths skewed packing.

samir: past 6m logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:18Z  worker=usw2-rt-23 batch_size=24 seq_lens=[4,400,12,7,8,256,...] op=pack_streaming
2026-03-15T12:03:19Z  worker=usw2-rt-23 kv_hit=false paging=false
2026-03-15T12:03:19Z  worker=usw2-rt-23 streaming_stall=1 token_idx=42
```

mira: that looks like packer greedily grouping short + very long sequences, causing padding and a long tail while streaming waits for long seqs to finish. Continuous batch scheduler fairness might be favouring throughput over latency.

tilly: can we throttle packer or force max_batch_size? Current config on that cluster: `max_batch_size: 64`, `prefer_latency: false`.

alex: propose temporary mitigations: 1) set `max_batch_size=12` on streaming pool, 2) enable `latency_first=true` scheduler flag, 3) create a routing rule to divert new customers to dedicated nodes (if available).

mira: agree. doing (1) and (2) now. 

mira: command run:
```
redwoodctl cluster patch --region=us-west-2 --pool=streaming-primary --set max_batch_size=12 --set scheduler.latency_first=true
```

samir: rolling config applied to 6/6 nodes. monitoring p99.

mira: immediate effect: avg batch_size dropped to 8, packing variance reduced. p95 back to ~320ms, p99 trending down from 2.5s -> 1.1s over last 40s.

tilly: adding a short-term packer override to prevent mixing sequences with >200 token differences. applying: `packer.max_seq_diff=200`

samir: applied. logs now show more homogeneous batches and fewer stalls. example:
```
2026-03-15T12:06:02Z  worker=usw2-rt-23 batch_size=9 seq_lens=[8,12,10,9,11,7,12,9,10]
```

alex: good. can we also enable a fallback path that serves long sequences on non-streaming (blocking) nodes so streaming doesn't wait?

mira: yes — creating routing rule to send requests with seq_len>256 to dedicated blocking pool.

mira: route rule pushed. verifying.

samir: telemetry: p99 now 0.95s, p95 280ms. streaming stalls count dropped by 92% in 2m. customer impact = minimal — no external pages.

tilly: documenting actions taken in incident ticket and will follow up with PR for conservative defaults: `max_batch_size=12`, `latency_first=true`, `packer.max_seq_diff=200`.

mira: handoff: I'm going offline in ~15m. tilly, can you own follow-up root cause (scheduler fairness + packer heuristics) and coordinate with runtime/packers team?

tilly: taking it. will open post-incident eval and schedule a working session with runtime. assigning to @samir and @alex for immediate config PRs.

samir: will add metrics to alert rule: split streaming latency by batch_size and seq_len variance. want to avoid regressions when packer changes.

alex: also recommend we add a canary check that simulates mix of very short + very long sequences and measures p99 streaming latency before rollout.

mira: incident summary to post: cause = continuous batching packer + scheduler behaviour packing mixed seq lengths into large batches; mitigation = reduced max_batch_size, enabled latency-first scheduling, packer seq diff limit, route long sequences off streaming pool; status = degraded -> recovered; no customer pages.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-1807 status updated -> Resolved (mitigated).

tilly: will pick up RCA doc later today. closing channel after handoff. :white_check_mark:

mira: thanks team :heart:
